cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. We're so glad you're staying. The guest bed is yours; just no food upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have my breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Lovely. After nine, please; we keep the kitchen quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. Breakfast food stays in the kitchen, though. Can you catch a later train?

mechanism: A warmly welcomes its former household pupil while adding breakfast restrictions, treating limited compliance as progress and refusing even a travel-food exception.
confusable: Not angry correction or conditional kindness: warmth and mentor concern remain while the rules progressively remove practical choices.
comparison: Guest breakfast before train versus swimming-club entry before induction.
seedUse: D189 guest bed/no upstairs food/nine/kitchen/banana/eight train; S05 taught crumb care.
